info.title: SigningHub Universal API
info.description: Send, review, approve, and sign documents digitally

post.description: Adds a digital signature field in SigningHub.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

packageId.description: The package ID for which the field is being added.

documentId.description: The document ID where the field is to be added.

order.description: Workflow recipient order for the signature field.

pageNo.description: Document page number where the field will be added.

fieldName.description: Optional field name. If omitted, SigningHub assigns one automatically.

levelOfAssurance.description: Signature assurance level, for example ELECTRONIC_SIGNATURE.

display.description: Visibility of the field, VISIBLE or INVISIBLE.

x.description: Left position of the field in pixels.

y.description: Top position of the field in pixels.
